description: One of Mappit's live map layers, for a place or the whole world: earthquakes (USGS), wildfires (NASA FIRMS), air_quality and weather (Open-Meteo), airport_delays (US airports with an FAA ground stop, delay program, delays or a closure now), flights (aircraft in the air within 250 nautical miles of a place, from adsb.lol; needs a place, not the world), airports (US airports nearest a place, or the busiest in a country or the world, with passengers, punctuality and the FAA's status, from BTS and the FAA), history (events on this day in past years), stocks (S&P 500 companies by headquarters), events (public event pins) and radio_tv (live news radio and TV streams). For the whole world, air quality lists the worst readings first and weather the hottest.

date.description: For history and stocks: a date like "2026-09-28" (history uses its month and day). Default today.

layer.description: One of: earthquakes, wildfires, air_quality, weather, airport_delays, flights, airports, history, stocks, events, radio_tv.

place.description: Where: a place name, place id, country or "lat,lon". Omit for the whole world.

radius_km.description: Around a place, how far to look in km. Default 100.

name: get_map_layer
title: Map layer
